items.text: Ebikwata ku baana ba Amoni bye bino.
Lwaki abantu be batutte ebibuga by'e Gaadi?
Mudduke mudde eno n'eri mu bisenge by'ekibuga,
"Naye oluvannyuma ndikomyawo nate omukisa gy'abaana ba Amoni,"
Mukyuke mudduke mwekweke mu mpuku eziri ewala
Abaana be, n'ab'eŋŋanda ze n'ab'omuliraano baakuzikirira,
Katonda nti, "Obanga abo abatandinywedde ku kikompe bawaliriziddwa okukinywako, lwaki mmwe temubonerezebwa? Temuuleme kubonerezebwa, mulina okukinywa.
Katonda nti, "Bozula alifuuka matongo era ekibuga ekijjudde entiisa, ekinyoomebwa era ekikolimire, era ebibuga bye byonna biriba matongo emirembe gyonna."
Omubaka yatumibwa eri amawanga okugamba nti,
"Kaakano ndibafuula aba wansi ennyo mu mawanga,
Wadde nga muzimba ebisu byammwe okubeera waggulu nga eby'empungu,
Nga Sodomu ne Ggomola bwe byayonoonebwa,
ndigoba Edomu mu nsi ye amangu n'embiro.
Ani oyo omulonde gwe nnaateekawo akole kino?
Ani ali nga nze era ani ayinza okunsomooza?
Era musumba wa ndiga ki ayinza okunjolekera?"
Endiga ento mu bisibo za kuwalulwa,
alyonoonera ddala ebisibo byazo ku lwabwe.
emiranga gyabwe giriwulirwa mu Nnyanja Emyufu.
Laba, alibuuka mu bire ng'empungu n'atumbiira,
n'alyoka akka ng'ayanjululiza ebiwaawaatiro bye ku Bozula.
Ku lunaku olwo emitima gy'abalwanyi ba Edomu
Ddala abavubuka baakyo baligwa mu nguudo,
n'abalwanyi baakyo bonna ku olwo baakusirisibwa,"
Obubaka Obukwata ku Kedali ne Kazoli
Bino bye bikwata ku Kedali n'obwakabaka bwa Kazoli, obwalumbibwa Nebukadduneeza kabaka w'e Babulooni.
Weema zaabwe n'ebisibo byabwe bya kutwalibwa;
Mubeere mu mpuku empanvu, mmwe abatuuze b'omu Kazoli,"
Ndibasaasaanya eri empewo, abo abali mu bifo eby'ewala,
mbaleeteko akabi okuva ku buli ludda,"
Katonda ekyajjira nnabbi Yeremiya ekikwata ku Eramu, nga Zeddekiya kabaka wa Yuda kyajje alye obwakabaka.
Era ndireeta ku Eramu empewo ennya,
Ndimenyeramenyera Eramu mu maaso g'abalabe be,
Nditeeka entebe yange ey'obwakabaka mu Eramu
era nzikirize kabaka we n'abakungu be,"
